edits.text: PARTIES. This Agreement is between Vireo Systems Inc. and Jane Doe, the Executive.
edits.name: Aldous Finch LLP

edits.text: 1. POSITION. The Executive, Jane Doe, shall serve as Chief Operating Officer reporting directly to the CEO.
edits.name: Aldous Finch LLP

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive a Base Salary of USD 250,000 per annum, payable in accordance with the Company's standard payroll schedule, plus benefits as outlined in the Company's employee handbook.
edits.name: Aldous Finch LLP

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. On termination of employment by the Company without cause, the Executive shall receive severance equal to six months of Base Salary, payable in a lump sum within 30 days of termination.
edits.name: Aldous Finch LLP

edits.text: 4. NON-COMPETE. The Executive shall not engage in any competing business or solicit the Company's clients for a period of nine months following termination of employment.
edits.name: Aldous Finch LLP
